strongest_angle: Analyze the military escalation and diplomatic stalemate between Ethiopia and Eritrea at the border town of Adigrat as reported to the United Nations Security Council.

key_facts.fact: Ethiopian military vehicles and troops entered Adigrat near the Eritrean border on Saturday as residents celebrated.
Ethiopia submitted a letter to the United Nations Security Council accusing Eritrea of launching an all-out invasion.
Eritrea requested the United Nations to take deterrent measures against Addis Ababa amid rising border tensions.
United States Secretary of State Marco Rubio urged peace talks to de-escalate tensions in the Horn of Africa.

quotes.text: The all-out invasion of parts of northern Ethiopia by Eritrea is a matter of public record
quotes.speaker: Ethiopia’s Minister of Foreign Affairs
